# Karim Sangid — AI Engineer · Software Developer

> Personal portfolio of Karim Sangid, an AI engineer and software developer and the founder of Hummus Development LLC. He builds LLM applications end to end and measures them before they ship: tool-calling agents over retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation harnesses, and QLoRA fine-tunes on local hardware. Four of his apps are live on the App Store.

- [Case study: Wheaton Valet Cleaners](https://karimsangid.is-a.dev/case/wheaton): multi-brand Next.js 16 client build
- [Case study: SentinelIQ](https://karimsangid.is-a.dev/case/sentinel): security log analytics and anomaly detection
- [Case study: Papi AI](https://karimsangid.is-a.dev/case/papi): consumer LLM app for iOS with provider fallback chains

## About

Karim Sangid is an AI engineer and software developer and the founder of Hummus Development LLC (Nov 2021 to present), where he builds LLM systems and ships web, mobile and backend products for paying customers. Earlier roles: Field Engineer at Frequentis (May 2026 to Aug 2026); QA & Cybersecurity Engineer, then Field Engineer II, at NextgenID (Aug 2024 to Mar 2026); and Lead Technical Specialist at New Horizon Hosting (Aug 2020 to Apr 2022). M.S. Computer Science (in progress), George Mason University. CompTIA Security+ and Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204).
